title: Deploy PostgreSQL Primary-Replica
description: Set up PostgreSQL streaming replication with primary and replica, automated failover with Patroni.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Deploy PostgreSQL with streaming replication — primary, replica, Patroni for failover, and verify data sync.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: postgresql-15, patroni, etcd, haproxy
- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks
1. Install PostgreSQL 15 on both nodes
2. Configure primary with replication user
3. Set up etcd for DCS
4. Configure Patroni on primary
5. Configure Patroni on replica
6. Verify streaming replication is active
7. Insert data on primary, verify on replica
8. Test failover by stopping primary

### Verification
- Primary accepts writes
- Replica shows replicated data
- Patroni cluster shows healthy
- Failover completes successfully

flags.title: PG Running
flags.description: Run: systemctl status postgresql | grep active. What status?

flags.title: Replication Active
flags.description: Run: sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT client_addr, state FROM pg_stat_replication;". What is the state?

flags.title: Patroni Healthy
flags.description: Run: patronictl -c /etc/patroni/config.yml list | grep -c 'running'. How many running nodes?

flags.title: Data Synced
flags.description: Run: sudo -u postgres psql -d testdb -c "SELECT count(*) FROM test_data;". How many rows?

flags.title: Replica Lag
flags.description: Run: sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT CASE WHEN pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() = pg_last_wal_replay_lsn() THEN 0 ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp())::int END as lag;". What is the lag?

flags.title: Failover Works
flags.description: Run: patronictl -c /etc/patroni/config.yml list | grep 'Leader' | wc -l. How many leaders after failover?

flags.title: WAL Archiving
flags.description: Run: ls /var/lib/postgresql/wal_archive/ | wc -l. How many WAL files archived?

flags.title: Connection Pool
flags.description: Run: psql -h localhost -p 5000 -U postgres -c 'SELECT 1' 2>/dev/null && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'. Is PgBouncer responding?

title: Deploy MySQL Primary-Replica with GTID
description: Set up MySQL primary-replica replication using GTID-based replication for reliable failover.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Deploy MySQL 8 with GTID-based replication between primary and replica, ensure data consistency and test failover.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: mysql-8.0, mysql-shell, orchestrator
- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks
1. Install MySQL 8.0 on both nodes
2. Configure primary with server-id and GTID mode
3. Create replication user on primary
4. Configure replica with read-only and GTID
5. Start replication and verify GTID sync
6. Insert test data on primary
7. Verify data on replica
8. Test failover with Orchestrator

### Verification
- Both nodes running MySQL
- GTID positions match
- Data replicated correctly
- Failover completes

title: Deploy MongoDB Replica Set

briefing:

- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks

2. Configure each mongod with replica set config
3. Initialize the replica set

5. Verify primary election

### Tasks
1. Install GlusterFS on all 3 nodes
2. Configure trusted pool
3. Create replicated volume
4. Start and mount volume
5. Write test data
6. Verify replication across bricks
7. Configure geo-replication
8. Test node failure resilience

### Verification
- 3-node cluster formed
- Replicated volume active
- Data replicated to all bricks
- Geo-replication running

title: Deploy ZFS Pool + Snapshots
description: Set up ZFS storage pools with snapshots, compression, and send/recv for backup.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Deploy ZFS storage with pools, datasets, snapshots, compression, and zfs send/recv for off-site backup.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: zfs-2.1, zpool, zfs CLI
- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks
1. Install ZFS packages
2. Create zpool with mirror configuration
3. Create datasets for different use cases
4. Enable compression (lz4)
5. Create initial snapshot
6. Modify data and create second snapshot
7. Use zfs send/recv to replicate
8. Test snapshot rollback

### Verification
- ZFS pool created
- Datasets configured
- Snapshots taken
- Send/recv replication working

flags.title: Pool Created
flags.description: Run: zpool list | grep -c 'tank'. How many pools?

flags.title: Pool Healthy
flags.description: Run: zpool status tank | grep -c 'ONLINE'. How many ONLINE devices?

flags.title: Compression On
flags.description: Run: zfs get compression tank | tail -1 | awk '{print $3}'. What compression?

flags.title: Datasets Created
flags.description: Run: zfs list -t dataset | grep -c 'tank/'. How many datasets?

flags.title: Snapshots Exist
flags.description: Run: zfs list -t snapshot | grep -c 'tank'. How many snapshots?

flags.title: Snapshot Differ
flags.description: Run: zfs diff tank/data@snap1 tank/data@snap2 | grep -c '+'. Are there differences?

flags.title: Send/Recv Done
flags.description: Run: zfs list -t snapshot | grep 'backup' | grep -c 'tank'. Is backup replication done?

flags.title: Space Used
flags.description: Run: zpool list tank | awk '{print $3}' | head -1. Is space > 0?

title: Deploy iSCSI Target + Initiator
description: Set up an iSCSI target server and configure a client initiator to mount block storage.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Deploy an iSCSI target with LIO, create logical units, configure initiators, and mount block storage on clients.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: targetcli, lio, open-iscsi, curl
- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks
1. Install targetcli and iSCSI target tools
2. Create a backing store (disk image)
3. Configure iSCSI target and IQN
4. Create LUN and ACL
5. Install open-iscsi on client node
6. Discover and login to target
7. Create filesystem and mount
8. Verify block device access

### Verification
- iSCSI target running
- LUN accessible from client
- Block device mounted
- Read/write operations work

flags.title: Target Running
flags.description: Run: systemctl status target | grep active. What status?

flags.title: LUN Created
flags.description: Run: targetcli ls /iscsi | grep -c 'target'. How many iSCSI targets?

flags.title: LUN Accessible
flags.description: Run: targetcli ls /iscsi/iqn.2025.local:storage/tpg1/luns | grep -c 'lun'. How many LUNs?

flags.title: ACL Configured
flags.description: Run: targetcli ls /iscsi/iqn.2025.local:storage/tpg1/acls | grep -c 'acl'. How many ACLs?

flags.title: Client Connected
flags.description: Run: iscsiadm -m session | grep -c 'Connected'. How many iSCSI sessions?

flags.title: Block Device
flags.description: Run: lsblk | grep -c 'sd'. How many SCSI disks?

flags.title: Filesystem Mounted
flags.description: Run: mount | grep -c 'iscsi'. Is iSCSI mounted?

flags.title: Write Test
flags.description: Run: dd if=/dev/zero of=/mnt/iscsi/testfile bs=1M count=1 2>&1 | grep -c 'copied'. Does write succeed?
